name: Cislunar-Astrolabe
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs an orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
the pirate hideout was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
